claim: How often are listings updated on Zillow and Realtor.com updated?
summary: Zillow is about to get a lot worse in terms of accuracy when their feed from Listhub dies April 1. Realtor.com is supposed to be updated directly from the MLS feeds every 15 minutes. It is dependent on what information the MLS allows to be pulled and updated though. The original listing gets pulled along with the initial photos.
